# Aivro - Professional Static Website Design Agency

> Aivro is a professional static website design agency based in India that creates stunning, fast-loading websites delivered in just 1 week.

## About Aivro

Aivro is a static website design agency founded by E Charan Kumar Reddy and R Shakthi Prasad. We specialize in creating professional static websites for businesses, landing pages, and portfolios. Our unique selling point is delivering high-quality, custom-built static websites in just 1 week.

## Services

### Business Landing Page
Professional single-page website that showcases your business, services, and builds trust with customers. Includes custom design, mobile responsive layout, contact form integration, WhatsApp button, and social media links.

### Multi-Page Static Website
Complete static website with multiple pages - Home, About, Services, Gallery, and Contact pages. Up to 5 pages, fast loading speed, SEO optimized, image gallery, and Google Maps integration.

### Portfolio Website Design
Showcase your work beautifully with stunning gallery layouts, project showcases, about & contact pages, testimonials section, and resume/CV integration.

## FAQ

**Q: How long does it take to build a static website?**
A: Most static websites are delivered in 1 week. Multi-page websites might take 7-10 days.

**Q: Do you provide hosting and domain?**
A: LIMITED TIME OFFER: FREE Hosting Included! With our current offer at ₹5,599, we provide FREE hosting for your static website. You only need to pay for the domain name (typically ₹500-1000/year).

**Q: Can you redesign my existing website?**
A: Yes! We can redesign your existing website to make it modern and fast-loading.

**Q: What if I need changes after launch?**
A: We provide 1 month of free support after launch. Maintenance packages available from ₹2,000/month.
